name: Question 2
problem:
![](/home/jake/Developer/Course_Academy/reference/mathacademy/question-capture/14096579/assets/ebfc82cb392190b841d93a049c16f0c17f86491d315dcbcc8d2995d5e31cfc24.png)

What is the vertex of the parabola shown above?
worked_solution:
The vertex of a downward-opening parabola is the highest point of the parabola.

![](/home/jake/Developer/Course_Academy/reference/mathacademy/question-capture/14096579/assets/395e0c5d590f3394d0aea038865599b0c92e10b87243aac909e6522432e32c3f.png)

  

Therefore, the coordinates of the vertex are $(-2,0).$

Question 2
?

What is the vertex of the parabola shown above?

a
(2,0)
b
(0,−2)
c
(−2,−2)
d
(−2,0)
e
(0,2)
Submit
Correct
EXPLANATION

The vertex of a downward-opening parabola is the highest point of the parabola.

Therefore, the coordinates of the vertex are (−2,0).
